new_value: Already fixed on main by 85a70ec445 'fix(rust): complete upstream AddrForKey migration fallout' (2026-09-09, predates this bead's claim; bead description was written from a stale branch). Verified on current beads-worker-3 (main merged): cargo test -p lichen-gateway --test end_to_end = 22 passed / 0 failed, including all 8 tests named in the bead (gateway_rejects_replayed_authenticated_wire_before_forwarding, gateway_dio_carries_root_metadata, gateway_dio_reply_has_valid_ipv6, gateway_maintains_rpl_state_across_dis_packets, gateway_handles_rpl_dis_from_mesh_node, runtime_ingress_handoff_commits_after_protected_response, runtime_ingress_dispatches_authenticated_gcp_slot_claim, runtime_ingress_handoff_rolls_back_when_sender_state_persistence_fails). The fix took a stronger form than the bead's 'regenerate pinned constants': the harness now DERIVES DODAGIDs/addresses from lichen_core::addr::ygg_addr_from_pubkey (the i72x.2 upstream AddrForKey implementation - trust.rs:497 delegates to it) instead of hardcoding native-profile bytes; zero hardcoded 16-byte address constants remain in the file. lichen-gateway --lib also green (269 passed). lichen-node --lib has ~12 unrelated failures mapped to other open beads (8rm3 unicast-DIO gate, 5217 DAO forwarding). No code change needed; closing as no-op.
